headline: Overseas growth drives a sharp profit jump
summary_short: Amorepacific Group's Q2 2026 revenue rose 14.6% y/y to ₩1.2543tn as operating profit jumped 53.3% to ₩122.8bn, led by 28% overseas revenue growth.
summary_long: Group revenue grew 14.6% y/y to ₩1.2543tn and operating profit jumped 53.3% to ₩122.8bn. The flagship Amorepacific subsidiary grew revenue 17% and operating profit 59%, with overseas revenue up 28% to ₩551.6bn (99% operating-profit growth, double-digit margin) while domestic revenue rose 10% to ₩610.8bn (48% operating-profit growth, ~10% margin). Shard EPS was ₩1,280, up 146.6% y/y from ₩519 but down 18.6% q/q from ₩1,573. Growth was driven by online/MBS channel strength, major e-commerce events, and expansion of high-growth brands including AESTURA (triple-digit US growth) and COSRX (Amazon/TikTok Shop momentum). No forward guidance was disclosed.
confidence_notes: Net income and a consolidated EPS figure were not disclosed in the release; the shard's own EPS KPI (denominated in KRW despite the 'eps_usd' key name) is reported above as-is. Overseas operating margin was described only as 'double-digit' without an exact figure.

drivers.explanation: Growth driven by online and MBS channel strength, major e-commerce events, and expansion of high-growth brands.
AESTURA posted triple-digit sales growth in the Americas; COSRX ranked top on Amazon in Germany/UK and grew on TikTok Shop.
Domestic business held roughly a 10% operating margin while overseas business sustained a double-digit margin, per the release.
